help: usage: fleet-switchboard impact [-h] {floor,hold,clear} ... positional arguments: {floor,hold,clear} floor What the path-glob floor (and an optional independent rating) would decide for a PR hold What the daemon would label as held right now (read-only dry run; the daemon writes the labels) clear The owner's own terminal: clear a false impact hold for this head, with a reason (the Chief of Staff only under a standing order of the owner's, with --under-order) options: -h, --help show this help message and exit
